11861|2ff59fb5.name: Mor'rogal
11861|2ff59fb5.text:
Stonetalon Mountain has many perilous caves through out this region.  Exploring these caves can hold many adventures for those willing to risk life for glory.

$C, perhaps you seek riches that only following your heart and soul can garnish.

2980|e775a01e.name: Grull Hawkwind
2980|e775a01e.text: Greetings, $N, and welcome to Camp Narache. News of your arrival spread quickly among the tribe.

3030|1605f087.name: Siln Skychaser
3030|1605f087.text: The spirits have guided you to me. How may I be of service?

3412|d0fc10c2.name: Nogg
3412|d0fc10c2.text: If there were just a few more hours in a day...

3442|6812c5a7.name: Sputtervalve
3442|6812c5a7.text:
Interesting, interesting... I know of a druid that lives atop the hill above the Wailing Caverns, $N. She might be able to tell you more about this shard you have found.

Now, I must get back to work!

3442|c0ad1190.name: Sputtervalve
3442|c0ad1190.text: Lots to do, lots to do! The Union's given us deadlines and they're not the sort you want to miss!

3703|c3a4816f.name: Krulmoo Fullmoon
3703|c3a4816f.text: Have you come for further training? Shake the dust of the road from your garments, then, and let us get to work.

5054|8118a9f0.name: Krumn
5054|8118a9f0.text: Our ancestors teach us that while the individual must be strong, there is safety in numbers.  Do you wish to defend the honor of Thunder Bluff by organizing a guild?

5784|1a4f8770.name: Waldor
5784|1a4f8770.text: Your understanding of leather is deeper than my own. Perhaps you should visit the tauren Krulmoo Fullmoon in Camp Taurajo of the Barrens. He has much knowledge to offer a student of your talents.

5901|91558eae.name: Islen Waterseer
5901|91558eae.text: You've come further than many, $N. Respect the elements around you and you shall fare far greater than most.

7231|248686cb.name: Kelgruk Bloodaxe
7231|248686cb.text: What is it? Can't you see I'm busy?

7731|7161de72.name: Innkeeper Jayka
7731|7161de72.text: If we are to make these new lands ours then we must have places to rest our battle weary bodies. Lay your axe by the fire and share the stories of your mighty battles.

100-accept.name: Unknown
100-accept.text: Light explodes as you finish the incantation. The sounds of the water drops hitting the flame have died down and your senses are overcome as the corrupt spirits around you are destroyed.
100-accept.title: Call of Water

100-complete.name: Minor Manifestation of Water
100-complete.text:
Thanks to you. Thanks to the shamans.

Corruption ebbs but life continues to wane. Up to shamans to protect life.
100-complete.title: Call of Water

1087-accept.name: Braelyn Firehand
1087-accept.text:
You cannot imagine the hatred I possess for this wretched land. The ilk of Cenarius and the kaldorei druids at the peak employ their pathetic powers to stifle the flow of magic, even so far south of their pathetic holdings... their beloved forests.

Would that I could return to Jaedenar and exult in the flow of magic, but my master will not allow me to return until my work is done.

I have no doubt you love the night elves and their allies as little as I. Aid me, and both our ends might be satisfied.
1087-accept.title: Cenarius' Legacy

1130-complete.name: Melor Stonehoof
1130-complete.text:
So, $N, you have come.  Now, are you prepared to journey through distant lands?

If so, young $c, then listen on...
1130-complete.title: Melor Sends Word

1131-accept.name: Melor Stonehoof
1131-accept.text:
At times we hunt for food.  At times we hunt for honor.  And at times we hunt to earn the Earthmother's teachings.

But the hunt I now set upon you is none of these things.  It is to slay a creature outside the Earthmother's blessing.

The hyena Steelsnap roams the Thousand Needles, south of the Barrens.  He is a tyrant, attracting other hyenas to him and spreading fear and bloodshed among more peaceful beasts.

Find Steelsnap, $N.  Find him, and defeat him.
1131-accept.title: Steelsnap

1195-accept.name: Zangen Stonehoof
1195-accept.text:
The Galak centaur in the Thousand Needles are protecting an artifact from the time of the centaurs' creation.

We would like to retrieve it, but we require a phial of water from one of the night elves' moonwells.

To collect the water, you will first need to obtain one of the phials carried by the dryads near the Raynewood Retreat in the heart of Ashenvale Forest. There is a moonwell near the western bank of the Falfarren River, south of the main road, where you can fill the phial.
1195-accept.title: The Sacred Flame

1486-complete.name: Nalpak
1486-complete.text:
Your efforts shall not go unnoticed in gathering these hides, $N.

Thank you for your dedication.
1486-complete.title: Deviate Hides

1486-progress.name: Nalpak
1486-progress.text: I am very interested in examining the hides from the deviate creatures who have infested these caves. Have you had any luck in collecting some, $c?
1486-progress.title: Deviate Hides

1487-complete.name: Ebru
1487-complete.text:
As a Disciple of Naralex, I commend your bravery, $N.

Your aid in ridding the caverns is the first step in our long plight to see the Barrens restored.

Thank you and may you prosper.
1487-complete.title: Deviate Eradication

1491-complete.name: Mebok Mizzyrix
1491-complete.text:
Great, you got it!  I can't wait to try it out.  This is going to make me a fortune, I just know it!

Thank you, $N.  Take this, and after I'm rich I'll send you more, I promise!
1491-complete.title: Smart Drinks

1534-complete.name: Brine
1534-complete.text:
Wonderful, $N. With all three samples gathered, I can create for you a vial of the purest water any living creature will find. It will be used in the next steps of your rite of passage.

I am pleased to count you among our kind, $N. You do all $c proud, and I look forward to hearing about your exploits in the future.
1534-complete.title: Call of Water

1534-progress.name: Brine
1534-progress.text:
Do you have the water yet, $N? Tales say the ruins were protected by large creatures of nature that do not care for visitors, but those could be myths to scare off the enemies of the night elves.

Regardless, be careful.
1534-progress.title: Call of Water

220-accept.name: Brine
220-accept.text:
Islen will have one more task for you before rewarding you with your next totem. The vial of water I've given you is necessary for whatever that task is.

Go now and find her. We shall meet again some day.
220-accept.title: Call of Water

220-complete.name: Islen Waterseer
220-complete.text:
Ah, a vial of water created and blessed by Brine, and gathered by you, no less.

The liquid in this vial will be key in creating a sapta for you, but also used in one other task.

The sapta I create for you should be used to see the water spirits at the shrine in Silverpine Forest, south of the Undercity. The remaining drops, well, the remaining drops I will tell you about if you feel you are ready.

Are you prepared for one more journey, $N?
220-complete.title: Call of Water

220-progress.name: Islen Waterseer
220-progress.text:
Hello again, $N. You're looking well.

What brings you back to me so soon?
220-progress.title: Call of Water

2842-accept.name: Ghostheart
2842-accept.text:
As soon as we got word from Kernobee about the new gnomish rig, Scooty and I began work on the Transpolyporter 6000: The fastest and most reliable way to Gnomeregan.

It's finally ready for passengers to board, $N. If you want to give it a try, go to Booty Bay and talk with Scooty at the wind rider roost. To get to Booty Bay, take the boat from Ratchet.

Of course, you could always try and make the run to Gnomeregan through the dwarf infested mountains of Dun Morogh!
2842-accept.title: Chief Engineer Scooty

3369-accept.name: Falla Sagewind
3369-accept.text:
This shard holds great secrets; it is the pure essence of the Emerald Dream. However, what I see in this shard is not a dream; one would call this sort of a vision a nightmare.

I do not wish to alarm you, $N, but I think it is best if you deliver this shard into the hands of a wise druid as soon as you can.

Hamuul Runetotem on Elder Rise is who you need to find. Head to Thunder Bluff. I cannot say more.
3369-accept.title: In Nightmares

3369-complete.name: Arch Druid Hamuul Runetotem
3369-complete.text:
Falla sent you to me? Well now, let's see that shard that you say she was so hesitant to talk about...

<Hamuul peers into the shard>

Oh... I didn't... Well.

$N, thank you for delivering this to me. It isn't wise to speak of things such as this, though, I advise you. These are matters that you should not concern yourself with.

Let's just say that things in the Emerald Dream are not as we thought...

Perhaps in the future, our paths may cross again.
3369-complete.title: In Nightmares

3369-progress.name: Arch Druid Hamuul Runetotem
3369-progress.text: May I help you with something?
3369-progress.title: In Nightmares

3924-complete.name: Rilli Greasygob
3924-complete.text:
You got the manual!  I can't wait to read it and find out how to fix the Samophlange!  I spoke with Sputtervalve in Ratchet--he wanted to thank you for your help, and wanted to reward your efforts.

I want to thank you too, and if I ever get this thing fixed I'll let you know...
3924-complete.title: Samophlange Manual

6282-accept.name: Maggran Earthbinder
6282-accept.text:
Tauren take pride as the protector of these lands. Undoubtedly you can guess why I am alarmed with the number of harpies that dwell here in Stonetalon.

The Bloodfuries are the source of the increasing number of harpies in Kalimdor; they encroach upon all likes of life preventing the innocent from leaving their boundaries.

I need you to cull the harpies, $N!
6282-accept.title: Harpies Threaten

63-accept.name: Islen Waterseer
63-accept.text:
Along the coast of Silverpine, west of the Sepulcher, you will find a shrine that has become tainted by the plague. The spirits there no longer speak to our people and it will be up to you to defeat the manifestation and cleanse the pool.

Take the elemental's bracers, along with the remaining drops of Brine's potion, and place them on the brazier. The ritual should be enough to summon a pure spirit for you to communicate with.

Bring me proof the task is done, and I will reward you with your totem.
63-accept.title: Call of Water

63-complete.name: Unknown
63-complete.text: You place the bracers atop the brazier and then pour the remaining drops of Brine's potion into the flame. The drops crackle as they hit the flame and you begin to incant the simple words Islen taught you....
63-complete.title: Call of Water

63-progress.name: Unknown
63-progress.text:
The brazier still reflects the ambient light from the area, and the flame shifts slightly as you move closer.

The corruption along the hills seems to have kept its distance, and besides the missing components, the brazier looks prepared for the ritual to summon a cleansed manifestation of water.
63-progress.title: Call of Water

6301-accept.name: Tammra Windfield
6301-accept.text:
Industrial greed and continuous war have wrecked the lands of Stonetalon. Only the blessings of the Earthmother can cure such injury.

$N, I will require you to seek a special seed, the Gaea seed. They are only found here in Stonetalon Mountain, north of Sun Rock Retreat at Mirkfallon Lake, near the water's edge.

Once you bring me the seeds I will imbue them with shamanistic power to speed their growth.
6301-accept.title: Cycle of Rebirth

6393-accept.name: Tsunaman
6393-accept.text:
The Tribunal of the Tides has sent me to wage war on the fire elementals here in Stonetalon Mountain. Neptulon the Tidehunter, Lord of all water elementals, has taken a personal interest in seeing our fiery cousins extinguished.

$N, you can help me gain favor with the Tribunal by destroying the fire elementals in Charred Vale. When destroyed, the fire elementals leave Incendrites. Return these to me and be rewarded.
6393-accept.title: Elemental War

6421-accept.name: Mor'rogal
6421-accept.text:
Something is amiss here in Stonetalon. Can you feel the tension in the air, $N?

Southeast of here lies a deep cave in Boulderslide Ravine. The kobolds there are frantically mining a rare crystal called Resonite. I need you to bring back some ore samples so that I can understand what's happening in that cave.  I also need you to investigate the depth of that cave.

Go young $c, it's imperative I know what evil lurks under these mountains.
6421-accept.title: Boulderslide Ravine

6461-accept.name: Xen'Zilla
6461-accept.text:
We Trolls here at Malaka'Jin have prospered from the land; Stonetalon Mountain offers great hunting for us to live on.

Lately, we have attracted the wrong dinner guests... the spiders in these mountains have been raiding our camps at night looking to steal our hunt.

If you were to help us kill off these ghastly beasts we at Malaka'Jin would be in your debt. Spiders are everywhere in Stonetalon - just head north from here and you will see what I am talking about.
6461-accept.title: Blood Feeders

6562-accept.name: Tsunaman
6562-accept.text: Je'neu Sancrea is in need of aid. He is at the Zoram'gar Outpost in Ashenvale. The Night elf forest is to the north of the Stonetalon mountains. You can reach it by traveling through Windshear Crag or by heading north through Barrens. Zoram Strand is far to the west of the forest. Be careful, $N. There are forces there that will not take to your presence kindly.
6562-accept.title: Trouble in the Deeps

6981-accept.name: Unknown
6981-accept.text:
The shard is a brilliant green, and although solid, what looks like smoke swirls just below the surface. You can't help staring into the depths of the crystal; at the same time, you know there is something very disturbing about it.

Maybe you should see if anyone in Ratchet can tell you more about this strange shard.
6981-accept.title: The Glowing Shard

6981-complete.name: Falla Sagewind
6981-complete.text: Oh... I have never seen anything like this...
6981-complete.title: The Glowing Shard

6981-progress.name: Falla Sagewind
6981-progress.text: Hello, $r. What can I do for you?
6981-progress.title: The Glowing Shard

747-accept.name: Grull Hawkwind
747-accept.text:
You have a promising air about you, and will prove yourself to the tribe. Perhaps someday soon you will be welcomed into the great city of Thunder Bluff. But before that can happen you must prove yourself to my father, Chief Hawkwind.

Up here on Red Cloud Mesa we pride ourselves on keen hunting skills. $R hunt out of necessity and for sport. Our supply of meats has run low and we require feathers for clothing. Hunt the nearby plainstriders and prove yourself by resupplying the village.
747-accept.title: The Hunt Begins

747-progress.name: Grull Hawkwind
747-progress.text: Providing meat and feathers for the tribe is the first step in proving yourself as a hunter before the Chief.
747-progress.title: The Hunt Begins

752-accept.name: Chief Hawkwind
752-accept.text:
All members of the tribe share in the harmony of life. We live together and work together.

Our commitment to one another carries with it a high degree of responsibility. I ask of you now a humble task.

My mother set out this morning to fetch water from the well to the southeast of Narache. It has been quite some time now. Perhaps you could check on her for me while I attend to tribal matters here?
752-accept.title: A Humble Task

86576-accept.name: Maggran Earthbinder
86576-accept.text:
In addition to spreading their filth across the Charred Vale, the Bloodfury harpies gather anything shiny that they can find. I'm told that they collect a variety of golden-yellow sunstones for decoration. I have no use for such trinkets, but Mor'rogal has mentioned using them before.

While you're fighting the harpies of the Vale, keep your eye out for Glittering Sunstones. Bring any that you find to Mor'rogal, up on the hills above us.
86576-accept.title: Bloodfury Trinkets

891-complete.name: Captain Thalo'thas Brightsun
891-complete.text:
Alas, the righteous Alliance guns have been silenced. You shall be rewarded for your aid, $N.

Now to tend to the grim task of recovering the bodies of the dead....
891-complete.title: The Guns of Northwatch

891-progress.name: Captain Thalo'thas Brightsun
891-progress.text: My fleet is in peril with Captain Fairmount and her damned cannoneers blasting away from Northwatch Hold. I want her soldiers to pay as well. Fill my hand with medals from their dead and I will know that vengeance has been given to my fallen privateers.
891-progress.title: The Guns of Northwatch

898-accept.name: Gilthares Firebough
898-accept.text:
Finally! Someone to rescue me!

I can't believe you got past the guards. These zealots from Theramore are out of their minds. They sank our ship and imprisoned me, the only survivor. I was called an enemy and threat to the Alliance.

Me! A threat to their great sham of an Alliance? I was a deckhand on a moonshine transport between Ratchet and Booty Bay.

Enough talk. Help me get back to Ratchet will you? Let me know when you're ready and we'll make our break.
898-accept.title: Free From the Hold

914-complete.name: Nara Wildmane
914-complete.text:
You have done it, $N.  You killed the leaders of the Druids of the Fang.  My dreams are now free of their wicked faces, and you have helped save the Barrens from a cursed future.

I thank you, $N.  I thank you for myself, for the druids of Thunder Bluff, and for the land.
914-complete.title: Leaders of the Fang

914-progress.name: Nara Wildmane
914-progress.text: Memories of my nightmares haunt me, $N.  Have you defeated the leaders of the fang and acquired their gems?
914-progress.title: Leaders of the Fang

92706-complete.name: Gazlowe
92706-complete.text:
Finally, somebody killed that thing! Do you know how hard it is to get a crew in the water when everyone in town's crying "Shark!"all the time?

I might just put that monster's fin into a soup for dinner tonight, just to have the last laugh.
92706-complete.title: WANTED: Bruuz

92706-progress.name: Gazlowe
92706-progress.text: What can I do for ya, $r?
92706-progress.title: WANTED: Bruuz

959-complete.name: Crane Operator Bigglefuzz
959-complete.text:
Superb! And just as I was about to lose my job too! I will see to it that Gazlowe gets this gift immediately.

Thank you, $N. Nicely done, I say!
959-complete.title: Trouble at the Docks

959-progress.name: Crane Operator Bigglefuzz
959-progress.text:
The dockmaster has been on my case ever since Mad Magglish made off with that 99-year-old port. I guess that bottle was intended as a gift for Gazlowe from none other than Baron Revilgaz himself.

If you're brave enough and patient enough to seek out Mad Magglish and get that port back, I'll see to it you get a nice reward.
959-progress.title: Trouble at the Docks

96-accept.name: Minor Manifestation of Water
96-accept.text:
Take shard. Take shard and give life.

Give life and understand. Understand water is life... corruption stops life.

You protect and give life with water's power.
96-accept.title: Call of Water

96-complete.name: Islen Waterseer
96-complete.text:
This is the proof I asked for. You've done well, $N.

I am pleased to be the first to congratulate you and give you this... your water totem.

Use it well, and good luck.

Your next test will not be for some time, so learn your lessons well. Pure water will not only give life back to those who are injured, but can have many other effects. I suggest you seek out a $c trainer when you have the time. They might have other spells for you to learn.
96-complete.title: Call of Water

96-progress.name: Islen Waterseer
96-progress.text:
You've returned. Splendid!

How went your journey to Silverpine? Did it take you long?

It is hard for me to tell if you were successful there because so much of the land has become corrupt. Its stench overwhelms any good that you might have done. But small successes are sometimes as important as large ones. Purifying the water there was instrumental for you, and for all shamans.
96-progress.title: Call of Water

962-complete.name: Apothecary Zamah
962-complete.text: Ah, splendid specimens. You have done well, $N.
962-complete.title: Serpentbloom

962-progress.name: Apothecary Zamah
962-progress.text: I am eager to see if you can gather enough Serpentbloom from the Wailing Caverns. I've sent many to do my bidding but none have returned.
962-progress.title: Serpentbloom

97538-accept.name: Tah Winterhoof
97538-accept.text:
Greetings, friend. I wonder if I may ask a favor of you? I have just run out of red pigment for my paints, and I am looking for one with younger hooves to make the long journey into the Stonetalon Mountains on my behalf.

In the middle of the mountain pass there lies a large circular lake, Mirkfallon Lake, that has a unique plant that grows within its waters. The pods of this plant, mirkweed, turn a vibrant red when dried. Gather the pods of this plant for me, and I will reward you well for your efforts.
97538-accept.title: Pigments for Paints
